business_overview.one_sentence: The group manufactures and sells architectural glass products in Southern China under the Hongguang brand.

segments.business_substance: Coated glass, insulating glass, laminated glass and tempered glass sold in the PRC.
segments.source: Annual Report 2024, Management Discussion and Analysis page 5 and note 4

segments.business_substance: Mainly dimming glass products sold in the PRC.
segments.source: Annual Report 2024, Management Discussion and Analysis page 5 and note 4

business_notes: All revenue was derived from sales of glass products in the PRC.
Customer A contributed RMB82.783m and Customer B contributed RMB27.851m in 2024.
